# B"H

## Boruch Hashem — Blessed is He

Chessed expands and Gevurah defines, Tiferes makes the pattern align;
The Awtsmoos gives each vessel purpose, so beauty and function can shine.

# Phase Three — Critique and Improvements

Thirty concrete safeguards/improvements:
1. inventory all social entry routes before styling
2. trace CSS imports before adding new imports
3. detect broad element selectors that can leak
4. detect duplicate class names across features
5. establish namespaced roots per surface
6. establish local token files
7. document a restrained z-layer scale
8. audit fixed/sticky positioning
9. audit horizontal overflow at 320px
10. honor safe-area insets
11. preserve semantic HTML
12. add focus-visible treatment
13. preserve keyboard activation
14. use minimum practical touch targets
15. add disabled/loading states
16. add empty/error states
17. add reduced-motion fallbacks
18. avoid animation on layout-critical properties where possible
19. remove duplicated listeners
20. centralize fetch/error normalization
21. avoid hidden implicit globals
22. make API response parsing defensive
23. keep DOM renderers separate from transport
24. keep touched executable modules compact
25. preserve public exports and routes
26. test alias identity switching
27. test series reader continuation
28. test heichel navigation depth
29. test feed interactions under slow/failing API responses
30. re-read every touched file and compare planned versus actual behavior

Decision: begin with shared social infrastructure and the most-used public surfaces, then fan outward to editors and secondary pages after browser evidence confirms the foundation.
